subject.title: fix(macos): keep Canvas hidden for agent content operations

question: Should macOS `canvas.snapshot` intentionally become fail-fast with `CANVAS_HIDDEN` whenever the panel is hidden, or must existing snapshot success be preserved without revealing or activating the panel?
rationale: The focus-stealing fix is valid, but the branch also changes an existing command's observable success behavior, and repository policy treats that compatibility tradeoff as maintainer-owned.

options.title: Accept fail-fast snapshots
options.body: Treat `CANVAS_HIDDEN` as the intentional macOS contract, retain the documentation, and require live proof before landing.

options.title: Preserve snapshot success
options.body: Revise snapshot capture to render without app activation or visible presentation, with focused tests and live proof for the hidden path.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-fast snapshots
recommendation.body: Treat `CANVAS_HIDDEN` as the intentional macOS contract, retain the documentation, and require live proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The change is authored and scoped as a single macOS Canvas ownership decision, making @steipete the clearest available decision owner.
